messages:
maya: Quick thread  NebulaGrid case study planning. Interview set Thu Jun 12 9:00am PT. Deliverables: launch blog, 30s testimonial, 15s social teaser, benchmark sidebar + possible joint webinar. Need quote + logo + metric clearance by Tue Jun 10 EOD.

otto: I'll run recording and pull a 4K still for hero. Can someone confirm if NebulaGrid wants an embargo? They mentioned a partner announcement window.

felix: Draft quote to propose (please tweak):
```
"Redwood let us serve in-production features with predictable latency, letting us ship a real-time analytics pane without risky infra changes." Asha T., Head of Data, NebulaGrid
```
Keep it short. Avoid pricing/percent unless they confirm.

trina: PR/lead plan: we'll route inbound demo leads from the launch to AE queue North-East and tag leads with: case_nebulagrid_launch + webinar_interest. Ops, can you confirm zap?

ops: Confirmed. Zap can push form leads to SFDC with lead_source=case_study and add tags. Need the exact form field for "interest".

legal-bot: Legal note: any numeric metric needs explicit written approval including date and signer. Also request logo SVG and a single-line approval: "Approved for public release by NebulaGrid, [date]". Route files to legal@redwood.example.

maya: Headline brainstorm (react):
1) Product: "NebulaGrid adds real-time analytics with Redwood Inference"
2) Outcome: "NebulaGrid ships real-time analytics without infra changes"
React :one: or :two:.

otto: I'll capture chapters so editors can grab 15s/30s cuts fast. Also will record a short "B-roll" ask for customer office shots if they can share.

felix: Proposed benchmark sidebar: latency p50/p95 before vs after (if they can share). If not, we'll frame it as qualitative improvement.

trina: I'll draft the launch cadence and webinar promo blurb: "Join NebulaGrid + Redwood on Jun 26 to see a live demo and lessons learned." Will we do co-hosted or Redwood-only?

maya: Ask them in the interview. If co-hosted, ops will flag webinar tag on leads.

(30m)

trina: DM from Asha: "Quote approved as-is. Attaching SVG. We approve publishing metrics: 20% median latency reduction. Please embargo until Jun 26 to sync with partner." Pasting drive link to SVG and approval line: "Approved for public release by NebulaGrid, Jun 18 2026."

legal-bot: Received approval. Legal sign-off logged. Please include exact wording and footer in the post.

otto: Great. Editors: include the 20% stat as provided and timestamp where Asha says it. I'll upload raw + chapters to /shared/marketing/nebulagrid after call.

felix: I'll incorporate the 20% stat into the benchmark sidebar and prep two headline variants with the stat.

maya: Final actions: Otto -> record + upload; Felix -> draft post + benchmark; Trina -> lead routing doc + webinar promo; Legal-bot -> store approval audit. We'll schedule embargoed publish Jun 26.

ops: Zap ready. Send me form field mapping and I'll turn on tags at publish.

maya: Thanks team  will create Asana card and assign reviewers. :sparkles:

(End thread assets & approvals saved to /shared/marketing/nebulagrid)
